crawl-batch.idempotency-key.evidence: Implemented at 085a8ec (branch claude/m2-batch on 881d3aa, main 97c2cee plus the group's first batch): BatchStartRequest.idempotencyKey and CrawlStartRequest.idempotencyKey (1 to 200 characters without control characters, 'idempotencyKey must be a string of 1 to 200 characters'), the x-idempotency-key / Idempotency-Key header merged into the body on POST /v1/batches, /v1/crawl and /fc/v1/crawl (a differing body key is 400 'idempotencyKey does not match the x-idempotency-key header'); the engine claims the key in <taskRoot>/idempotency.sqlite (new IdempotencyStore in @w2l/runtime: key, sha256 fingerprint of the parsed request with sorted keys, task id, 202 body, time; 24 h or until the task directory is gone) before creating anything, replays the stored body with replayed: true on the same fingerprint, answers 409 {error: 'idempotency key was used for a different request', code: 'conflict'} on another (CrawlStateError, now mapped in app.onError, Firecrawl's envelope on /fc), and records the answer before the task exists with no await between claim and record; MCP crawl and batch_scrape forward it, the hosted normalizer refuses it. Live at 21a5fb1 through the local API on 127.0.0.1:8807, HTTPS_PROXY 127.0.0.1:7890 (egress_proxy and evidence.envProxy on every item): A, POST /v1/batches {urls: books.toscrape.com/catalogue/page-1..5.html, idempotencyKey: 'parity-batch-idem-2026-10-02'} twice back to back (answers 5 ms apart) gave 202 {taskId: c7975ba3-…} and 202 {taskId: c7975ba3-…, replayed: true}, one task directory (3 to 4 under .w2l/api), completed 5/5 success on http in 5.9 s, each page requested once (5 egress_proxy events, requestCount 1 each); the same key with pages 1-4 answered 409 conflict and added no directory. Tests: runtime idempotencyStore.test.ts (fresh/replay/conflict, fingerprint, 24 h expiry with an injected clock, a missing task directory frees the key, file layout), contracts api.test.ts, api batch.test.ts (two POSTs one task, each URL once, 409, header alone, header/body mismatch 400), api firecrawl.test.ts (/fc/v1/crawl twice one id, 409 envelope, native header and body), mcp tools.test.ts and hostedToolPolicy.test.ts, sdk client.test.ts. Record: research/parity/m2-batch-live-checks-idempotency-append-chunking-2026-10-02.md.

crawl-batch.batch-append-to-id.evidence: Implemented at 085a8ec: BatchStartRequest.appendToId (1 to 200 characters, 'appendToId must be a non-empty string'); the body may carry only urls, ignoreInvalidURLs, idempotencyKey, robotsOverrides and the labels ('appendToId keeps the job's options; <key> cannot be changed'); the engine appends to Task.batch.urls (and robotsOverrides, invalidURLs) in order, refuses a total over 1000 ('batch would exceed 1000 URLs'), a URL already in the batch after canonicalization ('appended url is already in the batch: <url>'), a cancelled or failed batch (409 'batch is cancelled'), an id that is not a batch (404), answers 202 {taskId, requested, appended, invalidURLs?}, adds no job (the hosted active-batch limit does not count it), and leaves a running orchestrator to seed the tail (it re-reads the task row every 100 ms and on every work-loop turn) or relaunches a batch at rest as a resume; the orchestrator's final task write is built from the fresh row, so a list that grew during the run is kept, and the engine relaunches a completed batch that still has URLs without a step. A frontier seed passes the host scope (links keep it) and a batch's ladder policy lists no hosts, so an appended URL on a new host is fetched under its own robots.txt, SSRF and identity checks. SDK appendToBatch, MCP batch_scrape appendToId, hosted refusal. Live at 21a5fb1: B, POST 5 toscrape listing pages (202 taskId a8ebd9fb-…, status running, attempt 62fcf75f-…), 3 ms later POST {appendToId, urls: pages 6-10} answered 202 {taskId a8ebd9fb-…, requested: 10, appended: 5}; the status read 10 requested and 10 remaining under the same attempt; the batch completed 10/10 success on http in 5.0 s with the attempt id unchanged (every item in that attempt, seeded live), each page requested once through the proxy; a one-page batch cancelled 4 ms after its 202 (status cancelled, completed 0, no item, page-11 never requested) answered the append 409 {error: 'batch is cancelled', code: 'conflict'}. Tests: runtime frontier.test.ts (a seed outside the scope accepted, a link there host_denied), runtime orchestrator.test.ts (a URL appended while a page is held is fetched in the same attempt and the final row lists three URLs; an append after the run leaves the URL without a step and a resume fetches it alone), api batch.test.ts (live append with a localhost host, 5/5 one attempt, a replayed append; append to a completed batch, 7/7 in two attempts; duplicate, formats, over 1000, unknown id, crawl id, cancelled, each named; the append accepted under maxActiveBatches 1), mcp and sdk tests. Record: research/parity/m2-batch-live-checks-idempotency-append-chunking-2026-10-02.md.

crawl-batch.batch-url-chunking.evidence: Implemented at a41c1f0 in @w2l/sdk alone: chunkUrls(urls, chunkSize = 100) (an integer 1..1000, else RangeError 'chunkSize must be an integer between 1 and 1000'; an empty list gives []) and W2L.batchScrapeChunked(urls, opts, { chunkSize = 100, itemLimit = 50, pollIntervalMs, timeoutMs, maxRetries, signal }), which runs one batch per chunk strictly in sequence (batchScrape, waitBatch, listBatchItems), derives '<key>:<chunkIndex>' from a caller's idempotencyKey, merges the items in submission order and returns { jobs: [{ taskId, urls, report, invalidURLs? }], items, invalidURLs }; a WaitTimeoutError or W2LError from a job propagates naming it, and appendToId throws TypeError 'batchScrapeChunked cannot append; use appendToBatch'. No server change, no MCP tool, no /fc route. Live at 21a5fb1 with the built SDK against the local API on 8807 through the proxy: C, batchScrapeChunked(the sandbox's 50 listing pages, {formats: ['markdown'], idempotencyKey: 'parity-chunk-2026-10-02'}, {chunkSize: 20, timeoutMs: 300000}) ran exactly 3 jobs (bbc894ff-… 20/20, ae45d898-… 20/20, bba0ac8d-… 10/10, each completed with remaining 0, wallMs 11,310 / 10,162 / 7,731) in 30.3 s, returned 50 items, the 50 distinct URLs in submission order, every one success on http with HTTP 200 and 7,092 to 9,091 chars of Markdown, invalidURLs [], each job's report equal to its GET /v1/batches/:id and its task directory under .w2l/api; the 50 pages were requested once each, starts at least 249.8 ms apart (the per-host interval). Tests: sdk client.test.ts (2500 URLs into 1000/1000/500, chunkSize 0 and 1001 refused, 3 POSTs in order with keys k:0..k:2, items paged by 50 and merged in submission order from a reversed listing, appendToId refused, itemLimit 51 refused, a job that never completes surfaces WaitTimeoutError naming it). Record: research/parity/m2-batch-live-checks-idempotency-append-chunking-2026-10-02.md.
